description: Datamine provides software across the mining value chain: Studio GEO for implicit and explicit geological modelling, CAD and block models, Studio RM for resource estimation and geostatistics, a planning suite for design, scheduling and optimisation from strategic to operational horizons, production software for data collection and reporting across mining, processing and logistics, laboratory information systems, and ESG and sustainability data management. It is produced by Datamine, which reports more than 40 years of work, over 1,000 staff in 27 offices in 20 countries and more than 1,500 clients, and which recently acquired Commit Works and Mineware. Coverage is global in hard rock mining, coal and exploration. Software is sold as subscription-based role bundles, and prices are not published, so cost is paid. Caveat: the home page does not state current ownership, file formats or deployment details beyond the product list. For simulation it provides the resource models, mine schedules and production records used in capacity planning and optimisation, and in studies of how mines recover after flooding or supply interruptions. It is related to the Deswik and Micromine records in this catalogue, which are competing mine planning suites.
